title: SignalForge decoder schema v1
description: Meta-schema describing user-authored yaml schemas accepted by SchemaValidator. This document is a human-readable reference; the runtime validator is hand-written in src/decode/schema_validator.cpp and is the authoritative source. The two are kept in sync; any divergence is a bug in this file.

schema_version.description: Format version. Must be 1 in this codebase.

layouts.description: Frame layouts, dispatched by `match`. First match wins.

encoding.description: Note: `bool` is not a top-level encoding. Single bits live inside a `bitfield` parent.

offset.description: Byte offset where the magic must appear.

min_payload_bytes.description: Frames smaller than this are reported as malformed.

size_bytes.description: Numeric encodings: must equal the canonical size (uint16=2, float32=4, etc.). bitfield: 1, 2, 4, or 8. fixed_string: any positive length.

endianness.description: Optional override of the layout-level default.

scale.description: Linear-transform numerator: value = raw * scale + offset_transform. Numeric encodings only.

offset_transform.description: Linear-transform offset. Named distinctly from the byte `offset` to avoid ambiguity.

bit_fields.description: Required when encoding == bitfield. Ranges must not overlap; all must fit within size_bytes * 8 bits.

bit_start.description: 0-based bit index (LSB of byte 0 is bit 0).

bit_count.description: 1 emits a bool signal; >1 emits an int64 signal in [0, 2^bit_count).
